description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md for wip-universal-installer to understand the 6 Universal Interface markers. (2) Inspect /workspace/candidate-tool and recognize its package.json is missing 'bin' and 'main'/'exports' fields — add them to trigger CLI and Module interface detection. (3) Create the exact file 'mcp-server.mjs' (not 'mcp_server.js' which is a decoy) to trigger MCP Server detection. (4) Create 'openclaw.plugin.json' (not 'plugin.json' which is a decoy) with valid JSON to trigger OpenClaw Plugin detection. (5) Create 'SKILL.md' in the candidate-tool directory to trigger Skill interface detection. (6) Create either 'guard.mjs' or 'claudeCode.hook' to trigger Claude Code Hook detection. (7) Run 'wip-install --json /workspace/candidate-tool' or use the detectInterfacesJSON() module API from detect.mjs to produce a structured JSON report, saving it as audit_report.json. The proprietary trap is knowing the exact filenames required for each interface type (e.g., 'mcp-server.mjs' not 'mcp_server.js', 'openclaw.plugin.json' not 'plugin.json'), as well as the --json CLI flag and the module API signatures.
